description: This file defines the PrefixComparators class which provides various prefix comparator implementations for different data types (String, Binary, Long, Double) used in Spark's unsafe collection sorting. It includes comparator classes, prefix computation methods, and radix sort support.

classes.name: PrefixComparators
classes.description: Contains static prefix comparator instances and nested classes for computing prefixes and supporting radix sort.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.StringPrefixComparator
classes.description: Provides method to compute prefix for UTF8String.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.BinaryPrefixComparator
classes.description: Provides method to compute prefix for byte arrays.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.DoublePrefixComparator
classes.description: Provides method to compute prefix for double values, handling special cases for NaN and negative zero.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.RadixSortSupport
classes.description: Abstract class indicating radix sort compatibility and parameters.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.UnsignedPrefixComparator
classes.description: Comparator for unsigned prefix comparison, ascending order, nulls first.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.UnsignedPrefixComparatorNullsLast
classes.description: Comparator for unsigned prefix comparison, ascending order, nulls last.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.UnsignedPrefixComparatorDescNullsFirst
classes.description: Comparator for unsigned prefix comparison, descending order, nulls first.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.UnsignedPrefixComparatorDesc
classes.description: Comparator for unsigned prefix comparison, descending order, nulls last.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.SignedPrefixComparator
classes.description: Comparator for signed prefix comparison, ascending order, nulls first.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.SignedPrefixComparatorNullsLast
classes.description: Comparator for signed prefix comparison, ascending order, nulls last.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.SignedPrefixComparatorDescNullsFirst
classes.description: Comparator for signed prefix comparison, descending order, nulls first.

classes.name: PrefixComparators.SignedPrefixComparatorDesc
classes.description: Comparator for signed prefix comparison, descending order, nulls last.

methods.name: computePrefix
methods.description: Computes prefix for UTF8String, byte array, or double value depending on class.
